name: intrepidkarthi-skills
description: Karthik's personal Claude Code skills. Starts with write-like-me (strip AI-isms; write/rewrite in Karthik's voice).

plugins.name: write-like-me
plugins.description: Audit, rewrite, or generate content to strip AI writing patterns ('AI-isms') and invisible AI watermarks, and match the author's voice. Triggers on 'remove AI-isms', 'clean up AI writing', 'remove watermarks', 'strip invisible characters', 'write this like me', 'draft a post in my voice', or writing/rewriting a tweet, thread, or LinkedIn post.
